name: frame is scene
statement: A region that reaches the frame (edge distance at most 1 on two or more sides, the FRAME_MARGIN) has surrendered its outermost ring to the open — it is a scene, not a subject, and it is refused rather than measured as a figure. Point attention at the region to read the figure inside it.
where: src/engine/measure.rs: line 633 FRAME_MARGIN, measure() no-chosen refusal
applies_to: subject disposition (whole frame and region plays)

name: small is not subject
statement: A claimed figure must be substantial against the plate it came from: area fraction at least 5% of the whole plate AND at least half the plate's height or width. A small bounded object inside a scene is exactly that — an object, not the subject — and is refused with a request to point at the real subject.
where: src/engine/measure.rs: substantial() at line 549 (frac >= 0.05, half height or width)

name: opponent farness
statement: Separation is measured in opponent color space [L, R-G, (R+G)/2-B]: a figure must sit more than Z_FAR=6.0 standard deviations off its ground's border median, where the ground's spread is a robust MAD*1.4826 (floor 1.2) of the border ring. A plate with no pixels that far is honestly refused — no separable subject — not guessed.
where: src/engine/measure.rs: opponent() line 179, ground_stats() line 187, mask_far_from() line 237, Z_FAR=6.0 line 161

name: pointed attention
statement: A pointed box re-derives the ground from its own perimeter and masks inside the box (a hard window): attention narrows the read, so a figure that runs off the frame or hides dark-on-dark against its surroundings can be found where the whole-frame measure refused. The committed fractions stay against the whole plate, so the box cannot fake substantiality.
evidence: test a_region_finds_a_subject_the_whole_frame_would_refuse; plates 3 and 4 committed by region play
applies_to: clarification of which region is the subject

name: speckle is noise
statement: A foreground patch smaller than 0.1% of the plate (total pixels / 1000) is sensor speckle, not content; the subject is assembled only from regions that survive the floor, and the mask that stays connected to a non-speckle region is the one that claims the figure.
where: src/engine/measure.rs: components() line 290, min_area = total / 1000 at line 292
evidence: measured against every plant plate mask (plates 1,5,6,7,8,9,10,20,23,31 refused under every region)

name: shared columns are one
statement: Regions that share x-columns are stacked views of one thing: a column cluster of regions claims the figure as one subject, while a region that does not share its columns stays on the record as an object beside the subject, never silently dropped.
where: src/engine/measure.rs: cluster_columns() line 343, subject choice in measure()

name: a request owes every answer
statement: A code request that engages with any answer owes every open aspect: when a request is given partial answers it refuses with its remaining questions rather than planning on half-truths; once fully answered, the answers fold into the structured intent (language, platform, and the rest as constraints) that the planner actually reads.
where: src/bin/gc.rs run_chat interlock; src/engine/clarify.rs resolve retention; src/engine/mod.rs rust gates 717/806
evidence: engaging a done request with one new answer refuses; the full fold demonstrably reaches the planner
